problem: On Moon and Mars missions crews are far from doctors: Mars replies can take up to 20 minutes each way and there is no resupply. Astronauts are not physicians, yet they must notice slow health changes (bone loss, heart adaptation, poor sleep, CO2 exposure) and act on them alone.

beneficiaries.how: See early, explained warnings from their own baseline and know exactly what to do.
